gem_guidance.text: You may want to use gems such as Shining Fire Opal and Veiled Noble Topaz to get as close to the Spell Hit cap (12% from talents and Totem of Wrath + 4% from gear) as possible, without going over and wasting stats in the process.
Cyclone Faceguard is the best Phase 1 helmet, sporting great stats and a meta socket allowing you to use the almighty Chaotic Skyfire Diamond .
